0022600142.text: The Thunder arrive 4-0 (3-0 at home, 1-0 on the road) and first in the Northwest and the West, on a four-game winning streak, for their fifth game of the season. The Mavericks are 2-2 (0-1 at home, 2-1 on the road), 7th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee), all listed as out, while Alex Caruso (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the Thunder won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
